title: LLMs as Cultural Archives: Cultural Commonsense Knowledge Graph Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating extracted cultural commonsense knowledge graphs (CCKG) across five countries for cultural relevance and correctness, and conducting human evaluations to assess whether the extracted assertions contain overly generalized, stereotypical, or unfair cultural assumptions.

Comparing the logical path coherence, correctness, and cultural relevance of knowledge graphs and generated stories when models are prompted in English versus the native languages (Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Arabic) of the target cultures.
